about_text_1: I have been learning game design and analysing games since 2021. I apply a systematic approach in game development and focus on systemic design. I favour creating simple mechanics from which emerge engaging dynamics similar to monsters in "Lethal Company" or abilities in the latest "Zelda" titles.
about_text_2: I'm into psychology as I love exploring player behaviour or effective learning techniques. To add to that, I follow industry research, such as Quantic Foundry's "Player Motivations".
about_text_3: Also, I have worked on games in unconventional genres, namely "puzzle-runner" and "action-typer".
about_text2_1o: I just love games! I have extensive gaming experience across all major platforms and in most genres, from casual to hardcore. I highly value player feedback, but also understand the games' business goals. I care about healthy team relationships, know how to resolve conflicts and find common ground. I base my reasoning on constructive arguments and can communicate my ideas clearly. I respect and practice a systematic approach to design and development (and life as well). My credo is: "lead with wonder, shape with reason." Skill-wise, I'm a generalist and can also take on the role of a Product Manager.
about_text2_1: I just love games! I have extensive gaming experience across a wide range of genres, from casual to hardcore, on PC and mobile. I practice a product-oriented and systemic approach in my work (and in life as well). Skill-wise, I'm a Generalist and a Feature/Product Owner, covering the full development cycle: concept, documentation, support, configuration, testing, iteration, and post-analysis.
My credo is: Lead with wonder, Shape with reason!
